title: Street Layout Varying From Maps
previewText: Where the street layout actually on the ground varies from the street layout as shown on the zoning maps, the designation as shown on such maps shall be applied by the Board of Standards and Appeals, after public notice and hearing, in such a way as to carry out the intent and purpose of this Resolution.
